---
title: "Why LeBron James Stands Alone in NBA History"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Career regular-season totals from Basketball Reference
nba_greats <- tibble(
  player = c(
    "LeBron James", "Michael Jordan", "Kareem Abdul-Jabbar",
    "Kobe Bryant", "Karl Malone", "Tim Duncan",
    "Kevin Durant", "Stephen Curry", "Magic Johnson", "Larry Bird"
  ),
  points = c(43440, 32292, 38387, 33643, 36928, 26496, 30571, 25386, 17707, 21791),
  rebounds = c(12095, 6672, 17440, 7047, 14968, 15091, 7892, 4750, 6559, 8974),
  assists = c(12016, 5633, 5660, 6306, 5248, 4225, 4880, 6540, 10141, 5695),
  vorp = c(157.5, 116.1, 85.7, 80.2, 99.0, 91.1, 89.4, 76.5, 80.0, 77.2),
  is_lebron = if_else(player == "LeBron James", "LeBron James", "Other All-Time Greats")
)

nba_greats |>
  ggplot(aes(x = assists, y = points, size = vorp, color = is_lebron)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = player),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -1.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), limits = c(3500, 13500)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), limits = c(15000, 47000)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 14), name = "Career VORP") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("LeBron James" = "#FDB927", "Other All-Time Greats" = "#552583"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A Club of One: Scoring, Playmaking, and Total Value",
    subtitle = "LeBron James is the only player in NBA history with 40,000+ points and 10,000+ assists,\nwhile also leading all players in career Value Over Replacement Player (VORP).",
    x = "Career Assists",
    y = "Career Points",
    caption = "Source: Basketball Reference (Regular Season Career Totals)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
